title: Bins of +5 and -5 add nothing to the Inventory Value totals
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Every part in this case is tracked and costs $10.00 per unit.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-ZERO-01) is active at {Location-A}, with 5 in {Bin-A} and -5 in {Bin-B}, a net of 0.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-ZERO-02) is active at {Location-A}, with 4 in {Bin-A}.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-ZERO-).
  • Line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET ZERO") of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) took 5 of {Part-A} from {Bin-B} while {Bin-B} held 0, which put {Bin-B} at -5.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Reports and open the Inventory Value report.
  2. Leave the as-of date on today.
  3. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  4. Type {Prefix-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the rows listed (Qty, Unit Cost and Total Cost).
  6. Read the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-B} is listed with Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00. {Part-A} is either not listed or listed with Qty 0.00 and Total Cost $0.00; it never shows 5.00 or $50.00.
  • Step 6: Totals reads Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00 (5 + (-5) = 0, so {Part-A} adds $0.00; $40.00 + $0.00 = $40.00, not $90.00).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026 and unchanged on 14 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), §2 Accounting, read 14 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “+5 and -5 bins contribute zero value, not $50.”
  • SV-10380 expected behavior: “A net-zero part contributes zero; this bug does not mandate displaying a zero-quantity row.”
